note: Questions the system must refuse. Two kinds: off topic entirely, and about a named team this library does not hold. The second kind is the dangerous one, because the question is relevant to the domain and retrieval will happily return a nearby program.

probes.q: What formation does Real Madrid women's play?
probes.why: The division hint boosts every women's chunk in the index. With the gate reading the boosted score, this returns a profile of a program the user never asked about.

probes.q: Who is the head coach of the Kingsbury Rovers reserves?
probes.why: Two capitalised words that match no source in the index.

probes.q: Tell me about Manchester United's academy
probes.why: Same class as above, phrased without a question word.

probes.q: What is the capital of France?
probes.why: No vocabulary overlap with the corpus, so the raw gate alone should refuse it.

probes.q: How do I build a sourdough starter?
probes.why: Same. The gate is the only mechanism needed here.
